description: This Java abstract class manages API usage state, including cycle and hourly metrics, gauge calculations, feature toggles, and entity identification within the Thingsboard platform.

classes.name: BaseApiUsageState
classes.description: Abstract class for tracking and calculating API usage metrics, feature states, and entity info within the system.

classes.name: BaseApiUsageState.StatsCalculationResult
classes.description: Immutable data class representing the result of usage statistics calculations, including new values and change flags.

methods.name: calculate
methods.description: Calculates new usage stats based on input key, value, and service ID, updating internal state accordingly.

methods.name: calculateGauge
methods.description: Calculates gauge values by summing service-specific gauge data if report interval has elapsed.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Sets the current cycle value for a given key.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves the current cycle value for a given key.

methods.name: setHourly
methods.description: Sets the current hourly value for a given key.

methods.name: getHourly
methods.description: Retrieves the current hourly value for a given key.

methods.name: setHour
methods.description: Updates the current hour timestamp and clears hourly metrics and gauges.

methods.name: setCycles
methods.description: Updates cycle timestamps and clears cycle metrics.

methods.name: onRepartitionEvent
methods.description: Clears gauge and cycle data upon repartition event.

methods.name: getFeatureValue
methods.description: Returns the feature's current usage state value.

methods.name: setFeatureValue
methods.description: Sets the feature's usage state value and returns whether it changed.

methods.name: getEntityType
methods.description: Abstract method to get the entity type associated with this state.

methods.name: getTenantId
methods.description: Returns the tenant ID associated with the API usage state.

methods.name: getEntityId
methods.description: Returns the entity ID associated with the API usage state.
